items.name: metric-card
items.title: Metric Card
items.description: 测量定义、设备来源与实际观测组成完整卡片；趋势和范围是卡片内的可视化，质量与时效是数据上下文。

items.name: indicator-card
items.title: Indicator Card
items.description: 指标定义、计算结果和计算依据组成完整卡片，支持数值、分级状态和结构化结果；计算时间与输入统计窗口分别表达。

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Radix tabs with a shared sliding selection indicator, keyboard navigation and reduced-motion support.

items.name: iot-icons
items.title: IoT icon extensions
items.description: Ten original SVG icons for flow, air quality, pumps, valves, motors, field buses, pipes, tanks, enclosures and heat. Compatible with Lucide props.

items.name: graphite
items.title: Graphite Instrument
items.description: A tactile light and dark theme for shadcn/ui. Raised panels, recessed wells, and quiet controls.

light.pressed-background:
linear-gradient(
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--hover-top) 96%, black),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--hover-bottom) 96%, black)
  )
light.control-pressed-background:
linear-gradient(
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--control-top) 96%, black),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--control-bottom) 96%, black)
  )

dark.pressed-background:
linear-gradient(
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--hover-top) 96%, black),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--hover-bottom) 96%, black)
  )
dark.control-pressed-background:
linear-gradient(
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--control-top) 96%, black),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--control-bottom) 96%, black)
  )

:is(\n :is(\n [data-slot=\"button\"].transition:
border-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    box-shadow var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    scale calc(var(--transition-duration, 140ms) * 0.714286) ease-out

:is(:is([data-slot=\"button\"],button[da.background:
linear-gradient(
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--button-top) 96%, black),
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--button-bottom) 96%, black)
    )

[data-slot=\"tabs-list\"][data-indicator.transition:
transform calc(var(--transition-duration, 140ms) * 1.5)
      cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1),
    width calc(var(--transition-duration, 140ms) * 1.5)
      cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1),
    height calc(var(--transition-duration, 140ms) * 1.5)
      cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)

[data-slot=\"tabs-trigger\"].transition:
color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    background-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    border-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    box-shadow var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out

:is(\n [data-slot=\"navigation-link\"],.transition:
color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    background-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    box-shadow var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out

:is(\n [data-slot=\"dropdown-menu-item\.transition:
background-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    box-shadow var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out

[data-slot=\"badge\"].transition:
color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    background-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out

:is([data-slot=\"checkbox\"], [data-slot.transition:
border-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    box-shadow var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out

[data-slot=\"switch\"].transition:
background-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    border-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out

[data-slot=\"switch-thumb\"].transition:
translate var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    box-shadow var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out

.status-led.box-shadow:
0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 45%, transparent),
    0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 22%, transparent)

.status-led[data-status=\"warning\"].box-shadow:
0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 45%, transparent),
    0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 22%, transparent)

items.name: telemetry
items.title: Telemetry utilities
items.description: Gap-aware time-series geometry and operating-range validation.

items.name: device-status
items.title: Device status
items.description: Readable online, attention, offline, and provisioning states.

items.name: signal-strength
items.title: Signal strength
items.description: RSSI bars with a numeric dBm reading and an explicit unavailable state.

items.name: telemetry-chart
items.title: Trend inspector
items.description: 多序列共用时间游标，同单位共轴、异单位分图。目标带、事件标记、采样断点和精确数据表一起保留。

items.name: telemetry-card
items.title: Sensor data panel
items.description: 指标、测点、读数与单位构成传感器数据面板，质量、采样时效、量程和来源用于判断数据是否可用。

items.name: device-card
items.title: Device overview
items.description: 实物图、分类、序列号、型号与用途，连接、电源、位置和生命周期，以及配置与设备服务入口。

items.name: device-profile
items.title: Device Profile
items.description: 独立的设备档案布局：实物图、名称与分类、序列号与型号、用途、运行摘要，以及配置和服务入口。

items.name: threshold-control
items.title: Threshold control
items.description: A controlled operating range with numeric inputs, keyboard sliders, and validation.

items.name: data-freshness
items.title: Measurement trust
items.description: 分别呈现测量质量和数据年龄，展开来源、采样时间与接收时间。新鲜数据也可能无效，离线数据也可能保留有效历史。

items.name: range-gauge
items.title: Range gauge
items.description: A position track with a reference range, target interval and explicit out-of-range readings.

items.name: daily-histogram
items.title: Interval histogram
items.description: Caller-ordered interval bars with a zero baseline, signed values and an accessible table; no implicit aggregation.

items.name: control-mode
items.title: Control mode
items.description: Keyboard-accessible manual and strategy operating mode selection; authority is a separate component.

items.name: command-status
items.title: Command lifecycle
items.description: 从发送、接收、执行到回读验证，保留请求 ID、时间和期望值。超时明确标为结果未知，旧回执不能覆盖新指令。

items.name: actuator-switch
items.title: Actuator switch
items.description: Readback-driven binary device control with async acknowledgement, offline, and lock states.

items.name: setpoint-control
items.title: Setpoint editor
items.description: 生效值与草稿分开。范围、精度和步进校验在提交前完成；外部更新不会覆盖正在编辑的草稿。

items.name: actuator-control
items.title: Position control
items.description: 开、停、关保持固定位置。实际位置和目标分离，加入端限位、未校准、卡滞、控制权限制与反馈时间。

items.name: alert-card
items.title: Alarm state
items.description: 条件是否仍然存在，与人工是否已确认形成四种状态。严重度、来源、发生/恢复/确认时间及确认人分别记录。

items.name: event-timeline
items.title: Event timeline
items.description: An ordered timeline of actors, changes, and device events with an empty state.

items.name: automation-note
items.title: Automation note
items.description: Explainable suggestions with explicit human acceptance or dismissal and failure feedback.

items.name: data-workflow
items.title: Data processing workflow
items.description: React Flow editor for event triggers, multiple data sources, processing, conditional routing, parallel branches, joins and delivery. Execution is provided by the host application.

items.name: greenhouse-control
items.title: Greenhouse control
items.description: A composable greenhouse workspace for environmental readings, temperature setpoints, pumps, vents, and alerts.

items.name: fleet-overview
items.title: Device inventory
items.description: Browse devices by status or product, page through the inventory, and inspect a device in context.

items.name: device-control
items.title: Device configuration
items.description: An editable configuration with pending, offline, validation, and request failure states.

items.name: alert-console
items.title: Alert console
items.description: Review a filtered alarm queue, inspect its device and event history, then acknowledge or clear via application callbacks.

items.name: device-detail
items.title: Device detail
items.description: Inspect device identity, connection, measurements, static properties and events.

items.name: telemetry-explorer
items.title: Telemetry explorer
items.description: Query time ranges and metrics, compare trends, inspect raw samples, and optionally export the applied result.

items.name: device-groups
items.title: Device groups
items.description: Browse hierarchical device groups and the devices directly assigned to each group.

items.name: soil-profile
items.title: Soil profile
items.description: Locate physical probes by installation depth, inspect layer readings, and open their history.

items.name: soil-water-explorer
items.title: Soil water explorer
items.description: Inspect hourly soil moisture across depths and a full year, with shared time windows, interval climate records, concurrent events and raw-data export.

items.name: light-control
items.title: Light control
items.description: 按设备能力提供开关、亮度、色温、颜色与场景。逐设备结果揭示群组的部分失败，草稿不会冒充设备回读。

items.name: thermostat-control
items.title: Thermostat
items.description: 实测温度、目标温度、模式与当前运行状态分别显示。支持双设定点、临时覆盖、能力限制和外部更新冲突。

items.name: control-authority
items.title: Control authority
items.description: 区分本地/远程、手动/策略、当前持有者和临时覆盖期限。期限到达只提示待确认，不擅自宣告控制权已释放。

items.name: interlock-status
items.title: Permissives & interlocks
items.description: 将阻止操作的原因拆成可追溯条件，逐项呈现满足、未满足、未知与陈旧。总判定由设备或控制服务提供。

items.name: irrigation-run
items.title: Irrigation run
items.description: 围绕任务、分区、计划量、累计量和实际流量组织信息。暂停与结束任务分开；缺少总量或累计量时不伪造完成百分比。
